name: Static Web App
beginnerDescription: Hosts a static frontend with built-in global distribution and simple GitHub-based deployment.

name: App Service
beginnerDescription: Runs a web app or API without managing servers.

name: Azure Functions
beginnerDescription: Runs event-driven backend code and scheduled jobs.

name: Container Apps
beginnerDescription: Runs containerised microservices and jobs with auto-scaling and managed networking.

name: Azure Kubernetes Service
beginnerDescription: Managed Kubernetes cluster for container orchestration at scale.

name: Azure Cosmos DB
beginnerDescription: Globally distributed NoSQL or document database with low latency.

name: Storage Account
beginnerDescription: Stores files, images, logs, queues, and static assets.

name: Azure SQL Database
beginnerDescription: Provides a managed relational database for application data.

name: Azure Cache for Redis
beginnerDescription: In-memory cache for fast data access and session state.

name: Service Bus
beginnerDescription: Reliable asynchronous messaging between applications and services.

name: Event Hubs
beginnerDescription: High-throughput event streaming for telemetry and real-time analytics.

name: Key Vault
beginnerDescription: Stores application secrets, connection strings, certificates, and keys.

name: App Configuration
beginnerDescription: Centralised feature flags and application settings with fast retrieval.

name: Application Insights
beginnerDescription: Collects application telemetry, traces, failures, and performance data.

name: Log Analytics Workspace
beginnerDescription: Centralised log storage and querying for monitoring and diagnostics.

name: Azure CDN
beginnerDescription: Delivers content faster with edge caching and custom domains.

name: Azure Front Door
beginnerDescription: Global load balancer and web application firewall for scalable entry points.

name: API Management
beginnerDescription: Publishes, secures, and manages APIs with rate limits and developer portals.
